system.description:
Where lesser Malkavians inflict madness that fades, your power to twist the psyche has grown so great that you graft it permanently onto the mind, gifting your victim a dementia she will carry for the rest of her nights.

Speak to your victim for at least a minute, describing in vivid and precise detail the derangement you wish to inflict — this may pass as ordinary conversation, and you need not state your intent until you make the challenge. Then spend one Willpower Trait and make a Social Challenge. On success she receives one permanent derangement of your choice. You may inflict only one derangement per game session on a given target, though you may make repeated attempts until you succeed.
